MPx Player is an offline-first media player. Media indexing, metadata extraction, and playback happen exclusively on your device. Your file library is never uploaded to any remote server.
No tracking SDKs, no advertising identifiers, and no user surveillance frameworks are embedded in MPx Player. Your playback habits and files remain strictly your own.
Favourites, custom playlists, and playback resume points are stored in a private Room SQLite database (mpx_player.db) inside the Android protected application sandbox.

MPx Player is an independent, clean-room native Android media player. Its organization and UX workflow are inspired by MX Player (per reverse-engineered layout specifications). All code, views, and styling are rewritten 100% from scratch in native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose. No proprietary assets, code, or trademarks are incorporated.
MPx Player is provided \'as is\' without warranty under the Apache 2.0 License. Users are responsible for their own media files.
Pure native Kotlin rewrite with Jetpack Compose, AndroidX Media3 ExoPlayer, and Room SQLite persistence.
High-density, utility-first media management without cloud dependence, tracking, or ads.

Native Kotlin media player for Android with Media3 ExoPlayer and Room persistence.
Core offline playback and library features are fully functional native implementations:

Hardware (HW/HW+) and Software (SW) decoding via AndroidX Media3 ExoPlayer. Video gestures (double-tap 10s seek, horizontal drag scrub), aspect ratio controls (Fit/Stretch/16:9/Original), embedded and external subtitles (.srt, .vtt), and multi-audio track switching.
Picture-in-Picture floating mode with custom window controls on Android 8.0+. Real background audio playback for videos and music via foreground service.
Full MediaStore scanning for local tracks, albums, artists, and audio folders. Shuffle playback, track queue, and persistent MiniPlayer across all main tabs.
Custom playlists, starred favourites, and playback history with precise resume timestamps saved locally in mpx_player.db.
Four themes: Midnight OLED (#000000 cinema black), Dark Slate, Classic Navy, and Light Cinema. Immediate runtime theme application.
Bidirectional interface with full Right-to-Left (RTL) mirroring, mirrored icons, and instant language switching without app restarts.

MPx Player contains NO fake crash reporting, NO third-party telemetry, NO ad frameworks, and NO tracking SDKs. Your media playback history, favourites, and settings are strictly private and never leave your device.
We welcome bug reports, regression findings, and feature suggestions on our public GitHub repository. Your feedback directly shapes upcoming releases.
